hook.text: Got a sore throat? Try this before medicine. These 3 remedies work in hours.

woman holding neck sore throat winced
person coughing hand on throat closeup

tips.text: First, mix one spoon of raw honey with warm water. Sip it slowly. Honey coats your throat and kills bacteria naturally.
queries: honey dripping from spoon golden slow motion
person stirring honey into warm mug
woman sipping honey water cozy closeup
raw honey jar wooden spoon natural light

tips.text: Next, gargle warm salt water three times a day. Use half a teaspoon of salt in eight ounces of warm water. The salt pulls inflammation right out of your tissue.
queries: hand pouring salt into glass water closeup
person tilting head back gargling water
salt crystals macro shot white background
warm water glass steaming morning kitchen

tips.text: Last, sip fresh ginger tea with lemon all day. Slice fresh ginger, steep in hot water, add lemon. It reduces swelling fast and boosts your immune system.
